args.summary: The latest production deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks after rollout. Per the rollback runbook, checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent version that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms all regions are running v2.3.0 and healthy, with an error rate of ~0.2%. The bad v2.3.1 release should be investigated before any re-deployment.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Reviewed release history**: v2.3.1 (production) was deployed and immediately went unhealthy. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: all regions are running v2.3.0 and reporting healthy, with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification results. On-call has been paged.

Note: the unhealthy v2.3.1 should be root-caused before attempting a redeploy.
